text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Vodka's rival, 
Daiwa Scarlet, is fired up to claim both 
first place in popularity and in the race 
itself.

Meanwhile, Vodka wonders if simply chasing 
strength while competing against her like 
this is truly "cool."

However, sulking around is undeniably 
unbecoming. Switching gears, she headed 
toward the culmination of the year, the 
"Arima Kinen."
